## ✅ Checklist
Before submitting, please ensure:
- [ ] I have searched existing issues for similar requests
- [ ] I have provided clear use cases and benefits
- [ ] I have considered implementation challenges

**Note**: Feature requests should focus on improving audit procedures, data analysis capabilities, or user experience. Please ensure suggestions align with professional audit standards and practices.

**Community Involvement**: We encourage community discussion on feature requests. Please engage with others who comment and provide additional context as needed.
